text:
maya-k: Heads up — provisioning a new staging VPC in us-west-2 for the model fleet. Need to request quota bumps before we create NAT/GW and PrivateLink endpoints. Can someone from netops help with exact quotas to request? :wave:

samir: Sure. What are you planning for AZs/subnets and expected egress concurrency? Need numbers to size NAT/EIP needs.

maya-k: 3 AZs, private subnets in each, /22 per AZ for pods. Expecting ~30k concurrent outbound client connections at peak from GPU nodes (inference traffic + telemetry). We'll also create interface endpoints for the telemetry/private API and a couple of ALBs.

ryan-t: For NAT: AWS NAT Gateway is 1 EIP per gateway. With ~30k concurrent connections, port exhaustion might happen per EIP if we only have one per AZ. Recommend asking for Elastic IP quota increase and plan for 2 EIPs per AZ (so 6 total) initially. Consider having 2 NAT GWs per AZ and weighting routes if you need more headroom.

alex: Also remember interface VPC endpoints create ENIs per AZ per endpoint. If you open 4 endpoints we could consume a bunch of ENIs and security group rules. We should include ENI quota and security-group-per-network-interface quota increases in the request.

maya-k: OK list to request from cloud provider: EIP quota -> 12 (current 5), ENI quota -> 300, Security group per network interface -> 5 -> bump to 20, VPC prefix limit if needed. Also asking for EC2 Classic? no. Will add NAT Gateway quota if provider tracks it.

netops-bot: Suggested support ticket template below. Paste into console/support portal and attach account id and billing owner. :point_down:

```
Subject: Quota increase request for new staging VPC in us-west-2
Account ID: 123-456-789
Region: us-west-2
Requested increases:
  - Elastic IPs (VpcEips): from 5 -> 12
  - Network interfaces (ENI): from 80 -> 300
  - Security groups per network interface: from 5 -> 20
  - VPCs / subnets: confirm available /22 allocations
  - NAT Gateway count / throughput: confirm ability to run 6 NAT GWs (2 per AZ)
Reason: New staging inference cluster for GPU fleet with ~30k concurrent outbound connections and multiple interface endpoints for telemetry and private APIs. Need to avoid NAT port exhaustion and allow interface endpoints to attach ENIs.
ETA: deploy planned in 10 business days. Please advise if any further info needed.
```

samir: Add a note about ephemeral ports per EIP and the plan to distribute flows across multiple EIPs. If they ask for traffic numbers include 200-300 MB/s egress estimate per AZ (bursty).

maya-k: Will open ticket now and CC netops. Also tagging infra-bot to create an internal tracking issue. Thanks. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Internal ticket created: INFRA-2347 — "us-west-2 staging VPC quota requests". Assigned to netops.

ryan-t: Cost note: NAT Gateway is billed per hour per Gateway + per GB. 6 NAT Gateways will add ~\u0024X/day depending on egress. Consider using centralized egress with autoscaling or shared NAT for non-sensitive traffic to save costs.

alex: On PrivateLink: if we end up using many interface endpoints, we might hit the prefix list or route table association counts in large accounts. Add a short request to check route table association limits too.

maya-k: Added route table association increase to the ticket. Opening support portal now and will paste the template. I'll post the support case number when created.

samir: :eyes: Once the quotas are in we should run a small load test to verify no port exhaustion and check metrics for SNAT connections per EIP. I can help script that.

infra-bot: Support case created with provider: Case# 987654321. Status: Pending. Assigned to provider support engineer.

maya-k: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the case updates and a checklist for us-west-2 staging infra prep.
